attackers_goals: Obtaining persistency by assuming a role in the target's environment.
description: A cloud identity has created a new IAM role with trust policy that allows external AWS account access.
investigative_actions: Investigate any unusual activity originating from the suspected identity. Investigate any unusual activity performed in the assumed role sessions when originating from the allowed added accounts. Validate the legitimacy of the AWS accounts that were allowed external access.
name: AWS IAM Role Created with Cross-Account Access
